@jon1solution An easy work around would be to start doing ray casts. A call to `intersect_ray` will call `OptimizeBroadPhase` when too many bodies have been added and should get rid of this issue.

> [@mihe](https://github.com/mihe) I assume that an extra call to `JoltSpace3D::try_optimize` needs to be placed for running in the editor, but I don't know what the best place would be.

Yes. Unfortunately I can't think of a place other than `JoltSpace3D::add_*_body`, meaning we'd be calling `JPH::PhysicsSystem::OptimizeBroadPhase` for every 128 bodies that are added to the scene, which I guess would also mean we might as well remove all the `JoltSpace3D::try_optimize` calls from the queries.

I suppose we could bump that number up a bit, if that makes it any more acceptable.
